verdict.rationale: Alma's own materials cover O-1A/O-1B, H-1B, E-2, TN and green-card paths (EB-1, EB-2 NIW), plus the International Entrepreneur Rule. They also include founder-specific guidance on choosing a route, such as a ranked recommendation showing O-1A recommended, EB-1A strong and H-1B cap-subject as backup, and the O-1 as a foundation for later green-card petitions. Missing for 10: any documentation of cap-exempt H-1B routes (only the cap-subject H-1B is mentioned), in-depth E-2/TN guides beyond one-line descriptions, and independent corroboration of the selection guidance.
